summary: NVE Corp filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to report fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 financial results, plus a quarterly cash dividend of $1.00 per share payable May 29, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, strategic review, or restructuring activity is disclosed. The 8-K is purely operational and financial in nature, with no deal terms or special-transaction mechanics. There is no risk-arb angle; watch for routine earnings follow-up.
